field_tilt.definition: Share of both teams' completed final-third passes that are ours — an event-based proxy for territory.
field_tilt.label: Field tilt

final_third_entries_per_90.definition: Completed passes and carries that start outside the final third and end inside it, per 90 minutes.
final_third_entries_per_90.label: Final-third entries / 90

goals.definition: Goals scored by the team in the match.
goals.label: Goals

high_turnovers_per_90.definition: Possessions won back within 40 m of the opponent's goal (interceptions, recoveries, won duels), per 90 minutes.
high_turnovers_per_90.label: High turnovers / 90

pass_completion_pct.definition: Completed passes divided by attempted passes.
pass_completion_pct.label: Pass completion

ppda.definition: Opponent passes allowed in their own 60% divided by our duels, interceptions and fouls there (pressure events excluded). Lower is more aggressive pressing.
ppda.label: PPDA

progressive_passes_per_90.definition: Completed passes from the halfway line onward that advance the ball 10 m or more toward goal, plus any pass into the penalty area, per 90 minutes.
progressive_passes_per_90.label: Progressive passes / 90

shots.definition: Shots recorded for the team in the match.
shots.label: Shots

xg.definition: Sum of per-shot xG from the benchmark model (camera-observable features only).
xg.label: xG

model.coefficients_source: fitted on the bundled elite cohort with the benchmark feature set only
model.note: Both the reference cohort and the user's match are measured with this model and the same reduced feature set, so the xG below is a ranking quantity, not the app's headline xG.

model_card.note: In-sample: the model is fitted on this cohort and scored on the same shots. The numbers state how closely it reproduces StatsBomb's xG, not how it will score a new match.

population.label: StatsBomb elite cohort
population.source: StatsBomb open data (https://github.com/statsbomb/open-data) — events bundled in data/statsbomb_corpus, match metadata from the upstream open-data match index.
